import sys

def main():
    import sys
    input = sys.stdin.read().split()
    N = int(input[0])
    M = int(input[1])
    A = list(map(int, input[2:2+N]))
    B = list(map(int, input[2+N:]))
    
    A.sort(reverse=True)
    B.sort()
    
    swaps = 0
    for x in B:
        i = 0
        while i < N and x < A[i]:
            i += 1
        swaps += i
        A.insert(i, x)
        N += 1
    
    print(swaps)

main()
